module.hw_cpu.name: Processor
module.hw_cpu.desc: Model, cores and threads, clocks, cache, virtualization. The current clock comes from performance counters.
module.hw_cpu.caption: Identification
module.hw_cpu.note.temperature: Core temperatures, voltages and fan speeds require a kernel-mode driver — planned for a later phase.
module.hw_cpu.note.no_performance: Performance counters are unavailable — showing the rated WMI clock, not the current one.
module.hw_memory.name: RAM
module.hw_memory.desc: Memory modules, slot usage, clocks, vendor and motherboard limits.
module.hw_memory.note.no_array: The system reports no memory array (incomplete SMBIOS) — board limits unavailable.
module.hw_memory.note.no_modules: The system reports no memory modules — SMBIOS data is incomplete.
module.hw_board.name: Motherboard
module.hw_board.desc: Motherboard vendor, model, version and serial number.
module.hw_bios.name: BIOS / UEFI
module.hw_bios.desc: BIOS version and date, SMBIOS version, embedded controller and firmware boot mode.
module.hw_bios.note.ec: The embedded controller version is not reported by the firmware (SMBIOS returns 255.255).
module.hw_gpu.name: Graphics card
module.hw_gpu.desc: Graphics adapters, drivers, current mode and the real VRAM size.
module.hw_gpu.note.vram: WMI truncates VRAM to 4 GiB (32-bit field) and the registry entry is unavailable — showing a lower bound, not the exact size.
module.hw_gpu.note.none: The system reports no graphics adapter.
module.hw_monitor.name: Monitors
module.hw_monitor.desc: Monitors: model, vendor, production year, diagonal, native mode from EDID and current resolution.
module.hw_monitor.note.none: The system reports no monitor (for example remote desktop or no EDID).
module.hw_monitor.note.no_mode: No current display mode data from the graphics adapter.
module.hw_monitor.note.no_edid: Some monitors have no EDID block — native mode and diagonal may be unknown.
module.hw_battery.name: Battery
module.hw_battery.desc: Design and actual capacity, cell wear, voltage, charge or discharge power.
module.hw_battery.note.desktop: WMI battery classes do not exist on a desktop — this is expected, not an error.
module.hw_battery.note.cycles: Charge cycle count requires an IOCTL query to the battery driver — planned for a later phase.
module.hw_battery.note.critical: The battery reports a critical state — the cell may need replacement.
module.hw_disk_inventory.name: Drive inventory
module.hw_disk_inventory.desc: Every drive the system sees: model, interface, size, sector size, firmware, serial number.
module.hw_disk_inventory.note.usb: Some drives are connected over USB — such bridges often do not pass SMART or media size.
module.system_live.name: Live telemetry
module.system_live.desc: Charts of CPU load, clock and memory usage. Roughly one sample per second, history kept in memory.
module.system_live.note.waiting: No samples yet — telemetry is collected live in the GUI, so a one-off report has no data for this module.
module.system_live.note.interval: Sampling runs in the worker thread, so the interface stays responsive; the real pace depends on WMI response time.
